# websockets: dingtalk-stream 0.24.x uses async with websockets.connect(), broken
# on websockets <10 and has compatibility issues with >=14 due to the async
# context manager protocol. Range 13.x is the only known-good window for both
# dingtalk-stream and other consumers (firecrawl-py, fal-client, openai[realtime]).
websockets>=13,<14
